eco.title: Our ecosystem
eco.sub: One foundation, many missions, connected impact.
eco.intro.1: Borderless Foundation is a youth-centred ecosystem and knowledge hub that helps students and young professionals navigate education, career pathways and personal development with clarity and purpose.
eco.intro.2: Rather than a single programme, it is a set of specialised entities working together to connect ambition to opportunity and turn potential into real-world impact.
eco.mission.title: Our mission
eco.mission.text: To turn young people into globally minded changemakers by giving them access to opportunities, structured guidance, practical support services and partnerships across education, innovation and entrepreneurship.
eco.diagram.hint: Click a planet to discover each entity.
eco.how.title: How the ecosystem works
eco.how.sub: Each entity plays a specific role. Together they form a sustainable, scalable ecosystem.
